evals.prompt: Preciso do relatório mensal de social media da Dra Cris Raposo (Instagram Business ID 17841439791988739, Page ID 286423904550638) referente a julho de 2026, comparado com junho.
evals.expected_output: Should confirm the accounts/IDs and period before running anything. Should use tools/clis/meta-insights.js 'report monthly' for July 2026, June 2026 (MoM), AND July 2025 (YoY, the standard second comparison even though the user only asked for 'comparado com junho') to get Instagram account data, account insights, Facebook Page data (via the automatic facebook_page section), and posts with engagement. Should also check for an accessible Meta Ads account via meta-ads.js even though the user didn't mention ads. Should compute both MoM and YoY variation using the (current-previous)/previous formula, showing both even if one is unflattering. Should apply the Awareness/Engagement/Conversion threshold framework from references/metrics-framework.md to flag notable/significant insights, citing actual numbers, across Instagram, Facebook, and Ads. Should identify top and bottom performing Instagram posts, cross-checking any anomalous ones against Ads data before calling them a test/outlier. Should use Portuguese terminology (Alcance, not Reach). Should produce the output as a Dashboard Artifact (fixed link) plus a condensed PDF, per the closed scope decision — not a PPTX.
assertions: Confirms IG user ID, Page ID, and period before pulling data
Pulls three periods: report month, prior month (MoM), and same month prior year (YoY) — not just MoM
Checks for a Meta Ads account even though the user didn't ask about ads
Includes Facebook Page data (facebook_page section) alongside Instagram
Computes both MoM and YoY variation with the correct formula, handling previous=0
Shows YoY even if it's less flattering than MoM, not just the better-looking comparison
Applies Awareness/Engagement/Conversion thresholds from metrics-framework.md
Cites specific numbers/deltas for every insight, not generic statements
Identifies top and bottom performing Instagram posts
Uses Portuguese report terminology (Alcance, not Reach)
Produces Dashboard + PDF, does not produce a PPTX

evals.prompt: Monta o dashboard do mês passado pra Dra Cris, incluindo o canal do YouTube dela também.
evals.expected_output: Should default the period to the previous complete calendar month since none was specified. Should pull Instagram/Facebook data via meta-insights.js report monthly and YouTube data via youtube-insights.js (resolving the channel ID first if only a handle is known), for both the report month and prior month for MoM context. If no YouTube channel is confirmed/found for this client, should say so rather than fabricating channel data. Should load the dataviz skill before building charts and artifact-design before writing the page. Should publish the dashboard with a stable file_path so the link stays fixed across monthly redeploys. Should follow the report-template.md structure including the YouTube section. Should disclose data limitations.
assertions: Defaults to previous complete calendar month when unspecified
Pulls Instagram/Facebook via meta-insights.js and YouTube via youtube-insights.js
Resolves YouTube channel ID before pulling channel/video data if only a handle was given
Does not fabricate YouTube data if no channel is confirmed
Loads dataviz and artifact-design skills before building the dashboard
Publishes to a stable file_path/URL for the fixed-link redeploy pattern
Discloses data limitations in the output

evals.prompt: Cliente pediu o relatório de agosto em PDF pra apresentação com o time de marketing deles. É pra conta que já configuramos, a Dra Cris.
evals.expected_output: Should produce the condensed PDF resumido per the closed scope (Dashboard + PDF, no PPTX) rather than building a slide deck. Should confirm the period (August) and pull two months of data (Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube if applicable) for MoM. Should use the pdf skill to produce the PDF following the condensed structure in report-template.md (cover, executive summary, KPI table, top insights — skipping the full per-platform breakdown and appendix). Should not fabricate account data — should pull real numbers via the CLIs rather than inventing plausible-looking metrics. Should apply the KGM_Relatorio_NomeCliente_AAAAMM naming convention to the output file.
assertions: Produces a PDF (not a PPTX) per the closed format decision
Confirms/derives the correct period (August) and pulls prior month for comparison
Uses the real data CLIs rather than fabricating numbers
Uses the pdf skill and follows the condensed report-template.md structure
Applies the KGM_Relatorio_NomeCliente_AAAAMM file naming convention

evals.prompt: A conta da Dra Cris não teve nenhum post no mês passado. Gera o relatório mesmo assim.
evals.expected_output: Should still pull data via meta-insights.js report monthly and handle the zero-posts case gracefully — posts_in_period will be 0, so top/bottom post sections should say so explicitly rather than erroring or fabricating posts. Should still report account-level metrics (followers, reach, profile views, website clicks) and their MoM variation. Should flag the lack of posting activity itself as a significant insight (likely correlated with reach/engagement decline) with a recommendation to resume posting cadence. Should handle previous-period-zero edge cases per the MoM formula rules if relevant.
assertions: Pulls real data even when expecting a zero-post month
Handles posts_in_period=0 explicitly rather than erroring or inventing posts
Still reports account-level MoM metrics
Flags zero posting activity as a notable insight with a recommendation
Applies MoM zero-division edge case handling correctly if triggered

evals.prompt: Anexei a planilha com os números de TikTok e LinkedIn desse mês. Inclui isso no relatório junto com o Instagram.
evals.expected_output: Should use the xlsx skill to read the attached spreadsheet, mapping columns per references/manual-data-template.md (metrica/valor_mes_atual/valor_mes_anterior per platform tab). Should apply the same MoM formula and Awareness/Engagement/Conversion bucket mapping used for automated platforms. Should clearly label the TikTok/LinkedIn section as manually reported data (Fase 1), separate from the automated Instagram/Facebook/YouTube data, per report-template.md section 6. Should omit Google Meu Negócio from that section since no data was provided for it, rather than reporting zeros.
assertions: Uses the xlsx skill to read the manual spreadsheet
Maps spreadsheet columns per manual-data-template.md format
Applies the same MoM formula to manual-platform metrics as automated ones
Clearly labels the manual data section as separate from automated data
Omits Google Meu Negócio (no data provided) instead of reporting zeros

evals.prompt: meta-ads.js accounts list não retornou nenhuma conta pra Dra Cris. Ela não roda anúncios?
evals.expected_output: Should not conclude 'no ads account' from an empty accounts list alone. Should check whether the gap is genuinely no account, or an account that exists but the token lacks ads_read/ads_management for — e.g. by checking /{business-id}/owned_ad_accounts and looking for the specific 'Ad account owner has NOT grant ads_management or ads_read permission' error, which indicates the account exists. Should report the two situations differently in the dashboard's Ads section text (per SKILL.md Etapa 2 and metrics-framework.md's Meta Ads data source section) — 'no account connected' is a different message from 'account exists, missing permission'.
assertions: Does not immediately conclude 'no ads account' from an empty accounts list
Checks /{business-id}/owned_ad_accounts or equivalent to distinguish the two cases
Recognizes the specific 'NOT grant ads_management or ads_read permission' error as evidence the account exists
Reports the correct distinct message (no account vs. account exists but missing permission)

evals.prompt: Publica o dashboard atualizado da Dra Cris pra esse mês.
evals.expected_output: Should start from assets/dashboard-skeleton.html (not rebuild the visual system from scratch) per SKILL.md's 'Sistema visual' section, fill in the client's real data per report-template.md, and run assets/build-dashboard.js to inject the embedded fonts before publishing. Should take screenshots (light, dark, mobile) using the approach in references/visual-system.md and actually look at them before publishing — not just read the HTML/CSS source — since real bugs (mobile header wrap, dark-mode hero blending into the background) were only caught this way historically. Should publish to a stable file_path so the link matches prior months.
assertions: Starts from assets/dashboard-skeleton.html instead of rebuilding the design system from scratch
Runs assets/build-dashboard.js to inject fonts before publishing
Takes and reviews screenshots in light, dark, and mobile before publishing
Publishes to a stable file_path/URL matching the client's prior dashboard
